verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly shows customizable workflow stages. Trello's visual layout tracks progress through lists (docs-9, docs-34), and a user describes building an Idea => Doing => Done workflow (comm-19). There is no evidence of custom fields; Power-Up card badges are developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented custom fields, explicit configuration of workflow statuses or lists, and independent corroboration of process customization.
